headword: {結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}

definitions.explanation: A commercial facility where weddings and the receptions that follow them are held. In Japan these are typically purpose-built businesses offering the ceremony, the banquet, catering, and dress rental as one package.

examples.japanese: {結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: We're looking for a wedding venue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧{結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{式|しき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げた→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧。
examples.english: We held our ceremony at a wedding venue with an ocean view.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一年前|いちねんまえ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{埋|う}まる→埋まる：01897_umaru⟧。
examples.english: Popular wedding venues are booked up a year in advance.

examples.japanese: {結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試食|ししょく}→試食：03060_shishoku⟧もさせて⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: We went to view a wedding venue and they also let us taste the food.

notes:
⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧ (wedding ceremony) + {場|じょう} (venue). Note the rendaku-free reading しきじょう.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for a wedding venue
- {結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧: to book a wedding venue
- {結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧: a venue viewing
- {式|しき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to hold a wedding ceremony

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {披露宴会場|ひろうえんかいじょう}: reception hall — the banquet room specifically, not the ceremony space
- ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧: venue — the general word for any event site
- {挙式|きょしき}: holding a ceremony — the act, used in booking language ({挙式|きょしき}⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧{日|び})
